Introduction

Ayu is a Japanese singer. She used to be part of the pre-debut girl groups MuuTive and HitGirlz. She is currently a dancer under 1MILLION DANCE STUDIO. She also auditioned for Girls Planet 999 and Happyface Entertainment Japan (now Dreamcatcher Company).
